preserved_markdown.ASSET_LICENSE.md: License and dedication text. Do not change its legal meaning.
preserved_markdown.CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md: Adopted third-party Contributor Covenant text and enforcement policy.
preserved_markdown.THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md: License notices, attributions, and distribution statements.
preserved_markdown.experimental_modeling/examples/external_: Historical hash-bound external author contract. Preserve the request evidence.

mixed_scope.PLAN.md: Current introductory guidance only. Preserve the executed historical plan.
mixed_scope.TEST_PLAN.md: Current procedures. Preserve dated evidence and completed owner decisions.
mixed_scope.docs/backlog.md: Current contributor guidance. Preserve recorded decision facts.

embedded_guidance.Makefile: Help text. Preserve targets, variable names, commands, and result markers.
embedded_guidance.pyproject.toml: Project description. Preserve package metadata identifiers.
embedded_guidance.builder_cli/: CLI guidance. Preserve command syntax, status codes, and protocol output.
embedded_guidance.experimental_modeling/*.py: CLI help, help docstrings, startup and recovery guidance. Preserve runtime behavior.
embedded_guidance.experimental_modeling/review_static/inde: Visible text, tooltips, and accessibility labels. Preserve element identifiers.
Visible guidance and status descriptions. Preserve machine states and behavior.
embedded_guidance.scripts/: CLI help, shell usage guidance, and generated report prose. Preserve protocol output.
embedded_guidance..env.example: Operator comments. Preserve configuration keys and values.
embedded_guidance.deploy/vps/*.env.example: Operator comments. Preserve configuration keys and values.
embedded_guidance.release/dependency-policy.json: The seven manual_review reason fields generate current maintainer instructions. Names, identifiers, file lists, and dependency settings stay unchanged.
embedded_guidance.service/pyproject.toml: Service package description. Preserve package metadata identifiers.
embedded_guidance.service/src/hbcb_service/maintenance_mai: Maintenance CLI help and guidance. Preserve commands, status codes, and behavior.
embedded_guidance.experimental_modeling/requests.py: CLI guidance and exported author contract. Preserve identifiers and commands.
embedded_guidance.experimental_modeling/request_contract.p: Request contract diagnostic guidance. Preserve schema identifiers and field names.

generated_documentation.dependency_reports: scripts/dependency-audit and scripts/dependency-scan generate Markdown reports. release/dependency-policy.json supplies current manual-review instructions.

preserved_other: Legal quotations and third-party notice text
Code fences and quoted commands, paths, API names, hashes, schema names, and result markers
Historical logs, test evidence, and generated model evidence
Hash-bound requirement and verification report prose in experimental_modeling/requirements.py and verification.py. A text change would invalidate existing evidence.
Release license/source policy data, vulnerability dispositions, packaging notices, and fixture requirement records keep their recorded data.
review_limit: The script finds selected structural problems. Human review must examine meaning, part of speech, technical terms, procedure type, and safety.

historical_regions.TEST_PLAN.md: Recorded G0–G9 results, environment evidence, and dated security activation. Current procedures stay in scope.
historical_regions.docs/backlog.md: Completed v0.1 change record only. Current guidance and proposed work stay in scope.
historical_regions.experimental_modeling/examples/desk_crea: Original brief and recorded native results. Current reproduction and coverage guidance stay in scope.
historical_regions.experimental_modeling/examples/watering_: Recorded mutation outcomes, earlier measurements, and historical triangle correction. Current procedures and limits stay in scope.
